Welcome to our channel. The Tai Wai Small Animal & Exotic Veterinary Hospital is based in Hong Kong and our veterinary doctors will show you how to care and look after your pets. The vet doctors in our hospital will show you best practice techniques as well as providing tips. Our videos cover cats, dogs, turtles, tortoises, terrapins and chinchillas for now with more videos to follow so please subscribe to our channel.

The Tai Wai Small Animal & Exotic Veterinary Hospital was established in Hong Kong in 1997 by Dr Tiger and Dr Gail. The veterinary hospital was set up to not only cater for standard pets but also for small & exotic animals. Over the years the animal hospital has grown from only Dr Tiger & one vet assistant to 7 full-time veterinarian doctors & 30+ support staff. Our animal hospital is second to none & we have specialised facilities to care for exotic animals. 

We hope you find our videos useful and we welcome any questions and feedback!

Dr Gail & Dr Tiger
